# Ymir Tool context

Ymir Tool publishes a focused set of browser-based developer utilities and distinct troubleshooting guides. The maintained tool set covers JSON, Base64, URL encoding, JavaScript formatting, JavaScript regular expressions, text comparison, text counting, and Unix timestamps.

For direct actions, use the matching tool page. For failure modes, examples, and standards references, use https://ymirtool.com/guides.html. The site maintenance and testing method is documented at https://ymirtool.com/about.html#editorial-policy.

Users should avoid passwords, private keys, access tokens, customer records, unreleased source code, and complete production logs. Important output should be checked in the target system or against the relevant official specification.

## Transparency and maintenance
- Methodology: https://ymirtool.com/methodology.html
- Sources: https://ymirtool.com/sources.html
- Third-party licenses: https://ymirtool.com/licenses.html
- Changelog: https://ymirtool.com/changelog.html
